versions.content: If FrNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PN is set to requested or back to not requested (see SWS_FrNm_00423, SWS_FrNm_00424 and SWS_FrNm_00428) FrNm shall inform the upper layers by calling PduR_FrNmRxIndication() for the configured EIRA PDU (i.e. changed EIRA information shall be passed to COM)..

If FrNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PN is set to requested or back to not requested (see SWS_FrNm_00423, SWS_FrNm_00424 and SWS_FrNm_00428) FrNm shall inform the upper layers by calling PduR_FrNmRxIndication() for the configured EIRA PDU (i.e. changed EIRA information shall be passed to COM)..
